requirement: Describe ULTIMATE II as a Phase 3, randomized, multicenter, double-blind, double-dummy, active-controlled 96-week treatment study with 20 additional weeks of safety follow-up in relapsing multiple sclerosis.

evidence.text: The protocol identifies study design and treatment/follow-up duration.
The SAP restates the design.

requirement: Specify 1:1 IWRS allocation to ublituximab plus oral placebo or teriflunomide 14 mg plus IV placebo, retaining baseline EDSS stratum and geographic region in primary efficacy models.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies allocation, arms and analysis factors.

requirement: Define the primary endpoint as annualized rate of IRAP-confirmed relapses starting on or after randomization through last study treatment during the 96-week treatment period.

evidence.text: The protocol defines ARR as the primary endpoint.
The SAP operationalizes IRAP-confirmed relapse counting and exposure time.

requirement: Calculate treatment-group ARR as total confirmed relapses divided by total treatment-years, where treatment-years equal last oral or IV treatment date minus randomization plus one day, divided by 365.25.

evidence.text: The SAP gives the ARR and exposure-time derivation.

requirement: Use mITT for primary non-MRI efficacy: randomized, at least one dose, and at least one baseline and post-baseline efficacy assessment, analyzed as randomized; use mITT-MRI for MRI endpoints.

evidence.text: The protocol defines mITT and MRI subset.
The SAP confirms the populations.

requirement: Use all randomized ITT as a sensitivity population and PP as mITT treated for at least 1.75 years without major efficacy-impacting deviations, both as randomized; use corresponding MRI subsets for MRI sensitivity analyses.

evidence.text: The protocol defines ITT and PP roles.
The SAP adds MRI subsets and deviation review.

requirement: Define safety as all subjects receiving at least one study-drug dose and analyze toxicity, safety and ADA by first treatment actually received.

evidence.text: The protocol defines safety population and attribution.
The SAP confirms first-treatment attribution.

requirement: Compare ARR using negative-binomial regression/GEE with treatment, region, prior-year relapse count, baseline EDSS stratum, baseline Gd-enhancing lesion count, sex and baseline age, plus log standardized treatment-years as offset; report group rates and ublituximab/teriflunomide rate ratio with two-sided 95% CIs.

evidence.text: The protocol specifies the primary count model, offset and outputs.
The SAP gives the final primary model.

requirement: Test superiority of ublituximab over teriflunomide for ARR at two-sided alpha 0.05 and open the key-secondary hierarchy only after rejecting the primary null.
acceptable_values: primary must pass before secondary hierarchy

evidence.text: The protocol sets primary two-sided alpha and hierarchical testing.
The SAP confirms the testing gate.

requirement: Use fixed-sequence alpha-0.05 testing after ARR: Gd-enhancing T1 lesions, new/enlarging T2 lesions, pooled 12-week CDP, Week-24-to-96 NEDA, impaired SDMT, then percent brain-volume change; stop confirmatory interpretation at the first failure.

evidence.text: The protocol gives the ordered key-secondary sequence.
The SAP confirms step-down testing.

requirement: For 12-week CDP, pool ULTIMATE I and II only after ARR and the first two MRI endpoints are significant in both trials; if pooled CDP passes, resume NEDA through brain-volume testing separately within each trial.
acceptable_values: ARR and first two MRI endpoints pass in both

evidence.text: The SAP specifies the cross-study gate and return to individual-trial testing.

requirement: Analyze Gd-enhancing T1 and new/enlarging T2 lesion counts with negative-binomial regression, log number of usable post-baseline MRI scans as offset, and region, baseline EDSS stratum and corresponding baseline lesion count as covariates.
acceptable_values: log number of usable MRIs offset

evidence.text: The protocol defines MRI count models.
The SAP gives MRI derivations and offset.

requirement: Exclude centrally invalid/rejected MRI scans and scans within 30 days after systemic corticosteroids; derive lesion rates using Weeks 12/24/48/96 for Gd T1 and Weeks 24/48/96 for new/enlarging T2.

evidence.text: The SAP defines usable scans and timepoints.

requirement: Define 12-week CDP as EDSS increase at least 1.0 when baseline EDSS is at most 5.5 or at least 0.5 when above 5.5, not attributable to another etiology, confirmed at a scheduled visit at least 12 weeks later.

evidence.text: The protocol defines disability progression.
The SAP operationalizes time to CDP and censoring.

requirement: Repeat ARR for all reported relapses, time to first IRAP-confirmed relapse by adjusted Cox model, and all post-discontinuation relapses through end of study regardless of later treatment using log time-on-study offset.
acceptable_values: adjusted Cox time to first confirmed relapse

evidence.text: The protocol specifies the relapse sensitivities.
The SAP confirms them.

requirement: For consent-withdrawal dropouts other than deaths, perform 10-replicate multiple imputation of expected relapse counts using treatment, region, prior-year relapses, baseline EDSS stratum, baseline Gd lesions, sex and age; assess analogous dropout effects for key MRI and CDP endpoints.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the imputation sensitivity.
The SAP confirms ten replicates and covariates.

requirement: State there is no interim efficacy analysis; use blinded BART/DSMB sample-size reassessment near 210 of 220 randomized per arm, never reduce size, and permit at most 30 additional subjects per arm when the blinded pooled ARR is at most 0.19.

evidence.text: The protocol gives the blinded reassessment rule.
The SAP confirms no efficacy interim and preplanned BART reassessment.

requirement: Summarize safety descriptively through 20 weeks after last dose, including TEAEs through 30 days after last dose, SAEs, deaths, grade 3 or higher events, interruptions/discontinuations, AESIs, laboratory toxicity, vital signs, ECG, physical examination and suicidal ideation.

evidence.text: The protocol defines safety scope and TEAE window.
The SAP defines detailed safety summaries.

requirement: Confirm the exact negative-binomial parameterization and GEE working correlation, imputation model/distribution and pooling of the 10 imputations, CDP hazard-model/censoring details, and interpretation of tertiary nominal p-values before execution.

evidence.text: The plan defines the analysis families but extraction and source text leave these implementation details incomplete or open.
